en-US.title: Agent
en-US.gatewayHint: Use the Gateway HTTPS/WSS base address. Connect binds this device on first use.
en-US.qbHint: Enter the download tool IP or hostname, including a NAS or another device on your network. The port and API path are filled in automatically.
en-US.transmissionHint: Enter the download tool IP or hostname, including a NAS or another device on your network. Port 9091 and the RPC path are filled in automatically.
en-US.keepSecret: Leave blank to keep the saved value
en-US.targetHint: For a different address, download tool, username, or authentication method, enter the required password or API Key.
en-US.invalidUrl: Enter a valid address. Embedded credentials, query strings, and fragments are not allowed.
en-US.invalidSettings: Check the settings and username length.
en-US.invalidSecret: Secret values must be between 1 and 4096 bytes.
en-US.targetChanged: The connection target changed. Enter the credentials required by the new target.
en-US.credentialError: System secure storage is unavailable. Check system access permissions and try again.
en-US.storageError: Could not read or save local settings. Check file permissions and whether settings.json is valid.
en-US.runtimeError: The Agent operation failed. Try again or check the local diagnostic log.
en-US.timeout: The connection timed out. Check the address and try again.
en-US.networkError: Could not reach the configured service. Check the address, TLS certificate, and API access.
en-US.authenticationError: The download tool rejected authentication or API access. Check the selected authentication method, credentials, and access rules.
en-US.httpError: The configured service returned an unsuccessful HTTP response or redirect.
en-US.invalidResponse: The configured service returned an invalid API response.
en-US.unknownError: The operation failed. Check the local diagnostic log.
en-US.insecureGateway: Gateway requires HTTPS/WSS. Insecure transport requires explicit development configuration.
en-US.autostartError: Could not update login startup. Check OS permissions and try again.
en-US.invalidCommand: Gateway sent an invalid or expired command.
en-US.gatewayRequired: Enter a Gateway address and Agent Key before connecting.
en-US.gatewayProtocol: Gateway does not provide the expected client protocol. Check the address and server version.
en-US.legacyIdentity: This device uses an older protocol. Click Connect to migrate its local identity.
en-US.deviceLimitReached: The account has no available device slot. Manage devices in Popular, then connect again.
en-US.gatewayUnavailable: Gateway or its Popular backend is unavailable. The connection will retry.
en-US.gatewayRejected: Gateway rejected the request. Check the diagnostic log for the protocol error.
en-US.sessionRevoked: Connection authorization revoked. Click Connect to verify this device again.
en-US.introduction: Agent connects your local download tools to Popular Movie Center.
en-US.resetHint: Remove the saved download tool address, username and password? Existing downloads and task history will be kept.
en-US.downloaderRequired: Connect a local download tool first.
en-US.gatewayExplanation: Gateway connects Agent to Popular Movie Center to receive download requests and report task status. Your download tool performs the downloads and saves files in its configured folder.
en-US.downloaderExplanation: Keep Agent and your download tool running. If the download tool is stopped, Web access is disabled, or its address, port or access permissions are incorrect, Agent cannot add tasks or retrieve their status.
en-US.webAccessHelp: How do I enable Web access?
en-US.webAccessInstructions: Start your download tool and enable Web UI / remote access in its settings. Then enter its address, port and credentials in Agent. For a NAS, also allow access from the computer running Agent.
en-US.webAccessDocs: For setup instructions, see the official documentation:
en-US.documentationError: Could not open the documentation. Use the link address in your browser.
en-US.queueNotSynced: No queue snapshot yet. Connect Agent to Gateway to load pending tasks.
en-US.queueStale: Cached snapshot. The queue may have changed since the last sync.
en-US.queueEmpty: No pending tasks for this Agent.
en-US.queueLoadError: Could not update the queue. Your last snapshot is retained.
en-US.queueReason_agent_offline: Waiting to retry delivery to Agent
en-US.queueReason_executing: Waiting for the download tool to confirm
en-US.apiKeyHint: Requires qBittorrent 5.2.0 or later. Generate an API Key in qBittorrent Preferences → WebUI → API Key. This is separate from the Gateway Key.
en-US.queueLimitExplanation: {site} reported the daily download limit for this torrent. It has not been submitted to your download tool.
en-US.queueLimitPaused: Automatic retry is paused until the next attempt time (24-hour cooldown).
en-US.queueLimitDue: The cooldown has ended; waiting for Popular to retry.
en-US.queueExpiresBeforeRetry: This task expires before the next attempt.
en-US.overviewDescription: Your connections, local tools and next steps in one place.
en-US.resourceSitesDescription: Manage the sites your Agent can access locally.
en-US.downloadersDescription: Connect the tool that receives your downloads.
en-US.downloaderIntro: Credentials stay in this Agent’s secure storage. Files are saved by your download tool.
en-US.tasksDescription: Inspect pending requests and the reason each is waiting.
en-US.settingsDescription: Manage your Popular connection and application preferences.
en-US.readyDescription: Gateway and your download tool are connected. Keep Agent running to receive tasks.
en-US.setupDescription: Connect to Popular, then link a download tool on this device or your network.
en-US.needsDownloaderDescription: Popular can reach Agent, but downloads need a connected download tool.
en-US.stepGatewayDescription: Use your Gateway address and Agent Key to bind this device.
en-US.stepDownloaderDescription: Verify qBittorrent or Transmission before receiving downloads.
en-US.pendingRequestsDescription: Check delivery status, queue deadlines and site cooldowns.
en-US.localBoundaryDescription: Downloader and local resource-site credentials stay on this Agent.
en-US.sitesNotAvailableTitle: Local resource connections are on the way
en-US.sitesNotAvailableDescription: This version connects download tools. Site credentials, verification and resource requests will be added in a later update.
en-US.noSiteCredentials: No local site configuration in this version
en-US.languageDescription: Used throughout the interface and local status messages.
en-US.autostartDescription: Keep Agent available after you sign in to your computer.
en-US.notBoundYet: Bind this device to see its identity.
en-US.statusReadError: Could not refresh Agent status. The last known state is shown.
en-US.unsavedChanges: You have unsaved changes. Switching pages keeps your draft.
en-US.previewNotice: Interface preview · simulated data · no device connection
en-US.runtimeUnavailableDescription: Your settings are retained. Refresh status before changing the connection.
en-US.managementDescription: Manage this device’s connections and download tools.
en-US.managementSecretInitializationFailed: Unable to initialize Agent secrets. Check the secrets directory mount and write permissions.
en-US.managementMasterKeyMissing: Existing Agent data was found but the master key is missing. Restore the original master.key and check its mount.
en-US.managementLoginInvalid: Set WEB_LOGIN_USER and WEB_LOGIN_PASSWORD together. Use a username of 1–128 bytes without surrounding whitespace or control characters, and a password of 8–4096 bytes.
en-US.managementLoginHint: Use the account configured by WEB_LOGIN_USER and WEB_LOGIN_PASSWORD for this Agent.
en-US.managementPasswordHint: Use the admin-password file provisioned for this Agent. It is separate from your Popular Agent Key.
en-US.managementUnauthorized: The login credentials are incorrect, or your session has expired.
en-US.managementForbidden: The request origin or session verification is invalid. Check the configured Agent address.
en-US.managementRateLimited: Too many requests. Wait one minute and try again.
en-US.managementSessionExpired: Your session has ended. Sign in again to continue.
en-US.localSitesScope: Site credentials stay in this Agent. Enable Agent mode in Popular → Resources to use these sites and your local downloader.
en-US.siteEndpointHint: Use the trusted HTTPS site address. Changing it requires entering the credentials again.
en-US.sitePasskeyHint: Verification checks the Cookie login. Passkey is saved locally and is not submitted during verification.
en-US.siteDeleteConfirm: Delete the site settings and credentials from this Agent? Existing downloads are kept.
en-US.siteAuthentication: The site login has expired or was rejected. Update the credentials.
en-US.siteBlocked: The site requires a browser check or has blocked this request. Complete the check on the site; Agent does not bypass it.
en-US.siteRateLimited: The site is limiting requests. Wait before verifying again.
en-US.siteRedirected: The site redirected the verification request. Check the site address or renew the login.
en-US.siteRemoteError: The site could not complete verification. Try again later.
en-US.siteInvalidResponse: The site response does not contain one valid current-user identity.
en-US.siteNotConfigured: Configure this site in Agent first.
en-US.siteAccountChanged: The site now reports a different account. Enter the credentials again to confirm the replacement.
en-US.sitePasskeyRequired: Enter the Passkey again when changing the site account.

zh-CN.title: Agent
zh-CN.gatewayHint: 填写 网关 的 HTTPS/WSS 基础地址。首次连接时自动绑定此设备。
zh-CN.qbHint: 填写下载工具的 IP 或主机名，支持 NAS 等内网设备，自动补全端口和接口路径。
zh-CN.transmissionHint: 填写下载工具的 IP 或主机名，支持 NAS 等内网设备，自动补全 9091 端口和 RPC 路径。
zh-CN.targetHint: 更换地址、下载工具、用户名或认证方式后，请输入所需的密码或 API Key。
zh-CN.invalidUrl: 请输入有效地址，不允许内嵌凭据、查询参数或片段。
zh-CN.invalidSettings: 请检查设置和用户名长度。
zh-CN.invalidSecret: 密钥长度须为 1–4096 字节。
zh-CN.targetChanged: 连接目标已改变，请输入新目标所需的凭据。
zh-CN.credentialError: 系统安全存储不可用，请检查系统访问权限后重试。
zh-CN.storageError: 无法读取或保存本机设置。请检查文件权限及 settings.json 是否有效。
zh-CN.runtimeError: Agent 操作失败，请重试或检查本地诊断日志。
zh-CN.timeout: 连接超时，请检查地址后重试。
zh-CN.networkError: 无法连接所配置的服务，请检查地址、TLS 证书和接口访问。
zh-CN.authenticationError: 下载工具拒绝了认证或 API 访问。请检查所选认证方式、凭据和访问规则。
zh-CN.httpError: 所配置的服务返回异常 HTTP 响应或重定向。
zh-CN.invalidResponse: 所配置的服务返回无效的接口响应。
zh-CN.unknownError: 操作失败，请查看本机诊断日志。
zh-CN.insecureGateway: 网关 必须使用 HTTPS/WSS；明文传输需要显式开发配置。
zh-CN.autostartError: 无法修改登录启动设置，请检查系统权限后重试。
zh-CN.invalidCommand: 网关 命令无效或已过期。
zh-CN.gatewayRequired: 请填写网关地址和 Agent Key 后连接。
zh-CN.gatewayProtocol: 网关 未提供所需客户端协议，请检查地址和服务端版本。
zh-CN.legacyIdentity: 当前设备使用旧协议，请点击连接迁移本机身份。
zh-CN.deviceLimitReached: 账户没有可用设备名额，请在 Popular 管理设备后再次连接。
zh-CN.gatewayUnavailable: 网关 或其 Popular 后端不可用，客户端将重试连接。
zh-CN.gatewayRejected: 网关 拒绝了请求，请在诊断日志查看协议错误。
zh-CN.sessionRevoked: 连接授权已撤销，请点击连接重新验证设备身份。
zh-CN.introduction: 代理器可以让你本地的下载工具可以接入 Popular Movie 中心
zh-CN.resetHint: 清除已保存的下载工具地址、用户名和密码？现有下载和任务关联将保留。
zh-CN.downloaderRequired: 请先连接本地下载工具。
zh-CN.gatewayExplanation: 网关用于连接 Popular Movie 中心，接收下载指令并回报任务状态；本地下载工具负责实际下载，文件保存在下载工具配置的目录中。
zh-CN.downloaderExplanation: 请保持 Agent 和下载工具运行。下载工具未启动、未开启 Web 访问，或地址、端口、访问权限配置不正确时，Agent 将无法添加任务或获取下载状态。
zh-CN.webAccessHelp: 如何开启 Web 访问？
zh-CN.webAccessInstructions: 请先启动下载工具，并在其设置中开启 Web UI／远程访问，再将访问地址、端口和凭据填写到 Agent 中。使用 NAS 时，还需允许 Agent 所在电脑访问。
zh-CN.webAccessDocs: 具体设置请参考官方文档：
zh-CN.documentationError: 无法打开官方文档，请复制链接地址到浏览器中访问。
zh-CN.queueNotSynced: 尚无队列快照。连接网关后将加载待处理任务。
zh-CN.queueStale: 当前为缓存快照，队列可能已在上次同步后发生变化。
zh-CN.queueEmpty: 此 Agent 暂无待处理任务。
zh-CN.queueLoadError: 无法更新队列，已保留上次快照。
zh-CN.queueReason_verifying: 正在核实不确定的执行结果
zh-CN.apiKeyHint: 需要 qBittorrent 5.2.0 或更新版本。在 qBittorrent 设置 → WebUI → API Key 中生成；此密钥与 Gateway Key 不同。
zh-CN.queueReason_torrent_daily_limit: 单个种子当日下载已达上限
zh-CN.queueLimitExplanation: {site} 提示该种子的当日下载次数已达上限，尚未提交给下载工具。
zh-CN.queueLimitPaused: 自动重试已暂停至下次尝试时间（冷却 24 小时）。
zh-CN.queueLimitDue: 冷却期已结束，等待 Popular 重新尝试。
zh-CN.queueExpiresBeforeRetry: 任务将在下次尝试前到期。
zh-CN.overviewDescription: 集中查看连接、本地工具与待办事项。
zh-CN.resourceSitesDescription: 管理由 Agent 本地访问的资源站点。
zh-CN.downloadersDescription: 连接接收下载任务的本地工具。
zh-CN.downloaderIntro: 凭据保存在此 Agent 的安全存储中，文件由下载器保存。
zh-CN.tasksDescription: 查看待处理请求及其等待原因。
zh-CN.settingsDescription: 管理 Popular 连接与应用偏好。
zh-CN.agentReady: 已准备好接收下载请求
zh-CN.readyDescription: 网关与下载器均已连接。保持 Agent 运行即可接收任务。
zh-CN.setupDescription: 先连接 Popular，再接入本机或局域网中的下载器。
zh-CN.needsDownloaderDescription: Popular 已能连接 Agent，但下载任务仍需要可用的下载器。
zh-CN.stepGatewayDescription: 使用网关地址和 Agent Key 绑定此设备。
zh-CN.stepDownloaderDescription: 验证 qBittorrent 或 Transmission 后即可接收下载任务。
zh-CN.pendingRequestsDescription: 检查投递状态、队列有效期与站点冷却时间。
zh-CN.localBoundaryDescription: 下载器与本地资源站点凭据保存在此 Agent。
zh-CN.sitesNotAvailableTitle: 本地资源站点连接即将开放
zh-CN.sitesNotAvailableDescription: 当前版本可连接下载器。站点凭据、验证和资源请求将在后续更新中加入。
zh-CN.noSiteCredentials: 此版本暂不支持本地站点配置
zh-CN.languageDescription: 用于界面与本地状态提示。
zh-CN.autostartDescription: 登录电脑后保持 Agent 可用。
zh-CN.notBoundYet: 绑定设备后显示身份标识。
zh-CN.statusReadError: 无法刷新 Agent 状态，当前显示上次已知状态。
zh-CN.unsavedChanges: 你有未保存的修改，切换页面会保留草稿。
zh-CN.previewNotice: 界面预览 · 使用模拟数据 · 未连接设备
zh-CN.privacyNote: 已保存的凭据不会返回界面。
zh-CN.runtimeUnavailableDescription: 已保留你的配置，请先刷新状态，再决定是否修改连接。
zh-CN.managementDescription: 管理此设备的连接与下载器。
zh-CN.managementSecretInitializationFailed: 无法初始化 Agent 密钥或密码，请检查 secrets 目录的挂载和写入权限。
zh-CN.managementMasterKeyMissing: 检测到已有 Agent 数据，但缺少主密钥。请恢复原 master.key 并检查挂载路径。
zh-CN.managementLoginInvalid: 请同时设置 WEB_LOGIN_USER 和 WEB_LOGIN_PASSWORD。用户名需为 1–128 字节，不含首尾空白或控制字符；密码需为 8–4096 字节。
zh-CN.managementLoginHint: 使用此 Agent 的 WEB_LOGIN_USER 和 WEB_LOGIN_PASSWORD 配置的账号登录。
zh-CN.managementPasswordHint: 使用此 Agent 初始化生成的 admin-password 文件中的管理口令，它与 Popular Agent Key 不同。
zh-CN.managementUnauthorized: 登录凭据不正确，或会话已过期。
zh-CN.managementForbidden: 请求来源或会话校验无效，请检查配置的 Agent 访问地址。
zh-CN.managementRateLimited: 请求过于频繁，请等待 1 分钟后重试。
zh-CN.managementSessionExpired: 会话已结束，请重新登录。
zh-CN.localSitesScope: 站点凭据保存在此 Agent。在 Popular → 资源中开启 Agent 模式，即可使用这些站点与本地下载器。
zh-CN.siteEndpointHint: 请使用可信的 HTTPS 站点地址。更换地址后须重新输入凭据。
zh-CN.sitePasskeyHint: 验证仅检查 Cookie 登录身份；Passkey 保存在本地，验证时不会提交给站点。
zh-CN.siteDeleteConfirm: 删除此 Agent 中的站点设置与凭据？已有下载会保留。
zh-CN.siteAuthentication: 站点登录已失效或被拒绝，请更新凭据。
zh-CN.siteBlocked: 站点要求浏览器验证或已拦截请求。请先前往站点完成验证，Agent 不会绕过验证。
zh-CN.siteRateLimited: 站点正在限制请求，请稍后重新验证。
zh-CN.siteRedirected: 站点重定向了验证请求，请检查地址或更新登录凭据。
zh-CN.siteRemoteError: 站点暂时无法完成验证，请稍后重试。
zh-CN.siteInvalidResponse: 站点响应中没有唯一且有效的当前用户身份。
zh-CN.siteNotConfigured: 请先在 Agent 中配置此站点。
zh-CN.siteAccountChanged: 站点返回了不同的账户，请重新输入凭据以确认替换。
zh-CN.sitePasskeyRequired: 更换站点账户时，请重新输入 Passkey。
